findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 57 requests to 20 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

6 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amplitude.com (Amplitude, analytics), dotmetrics.net (Ipsos (Dotmetrics), audience measurement), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement), taboola.com (Taboola, advertising).
